content.text: Instead of hard-coding URLs on the client side, the server includes hyperlinks in its responses that guide the client on what actions can be taken next.
Client has to know all the endpoint URLs ahead of time.
The response includes links to related resources or actions.
Spring Boot supports HATEOAS through the spring-boot-starter-hateoas dependency.
